unused-toolchains.rust.name: Unused Rust versions
unused-toolchains.rust.line: Rust versions no project of yours uses
unused-toolchains.rust.what: Versions of Rust that rustup installed and that nothing on this Mac asks for.
unused-toolchains.rust.if-removed: Anything that asks for this exact version stops working until it is installed again.
unused-toolchains.rust.comes-back: Yes, with one command and a download; parts you added to it must be added again.
unused-toolchains.node.name: Unused Node versions
unused-toolchains.node.line: No project of yours asks for them
unused-toolchains.node.what: Versions of Node.js that nvm installed and that no project or setting on this Mac asks for.
unused-toolchains.node.if-removed: The global packages installed with it go too, and an editor set to this exact version stops finding it.
unused-toolchains.node.comes-back: Yes, with one command and a download; global packages must be installed again.
unused-toolchains.enabled.label: Unused versions of tools
unused-toolchains.enabled.description: Finds Rust versions that nothing on this Mac asks for. Each goes to the Trash and comes back with one command.
unused-toolchains.node-versions.label: Node versions (nvm)
unused-toolchains.node-versions.descript: Also finds Node versions nvm installed that nothing asks for. Off by default: the global tools installed with a version go with it.
unused-toolchains.reason.rust: Nothing on this Mac points at it. Last opened or changed on {date}. To get it back: {command}.
unused-toolchains.reason.node: Nothing on this Mac points at it. Last opened or changed on {date}. To get it back: {command}.
unused-toolchains.left-out.special: A running program may be using it, so it is kept.
unused-toolchains.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to macOS or another user, or is locked, so only an administrator can remove it.
unused-toolchains.left-out.partial-scan: Some folders could not be read, so a project there might use this version.
unused-toolchains.left-out.default-unkno: Fresher could not read which version is the default, so it keeps every version.
unused-toolchains.left-out.pin-unknown: A version file in your folders could not be read, so Fresher cannot tell which versions are used.
